$description: List (platform/components/List): the tokens of its ordered lists and steps (library wave 2); its icon list tokens are in components.tokens.json.

list-marker-text.$description: List: the color of an ordered list’s numbers and letters.

list-marker-min-width.$description: List: the width kept for a number or letter, so the statements line up.

list-step-size.$description: List: the circle of a step, the size of the line height.

list-step-background.$description: List: the fill of a step’s circle.

list-step-border-color.$description: List: the 1px border of a step’s circle, two shades darker than its fill.

list-step-border-width.$description: List: the width of a step’s border.

list-step-text.$description: List: the color of a step’s number.

list-step-font-size.$description: List: the size of a step’s number.

list-step-font-weight.$description: List: the weight of a step’s number.

list-step-radius.$description: List: the corners of a step’s circle (round).

list-nested-gap.$description: List: the space between a statement and the list nested under it.
